summary: This video previews Child of Chaos, a limited-time crossover support hero who can switch elements. His kit brings teamwide Control Immunity, AoE damage immunity (Ethereal), passive debuff/buff dispels with healing, and an execute mechanic for low-health enemies. His exclusive talent lets him ignore enemy Resistance, making Accuracy unnecessary in his gear build. Obtaining multiple copies for his Inspirations and Exclusive Artifact heavily boosts his team buffing and debuffing potential.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Provides teamwide AoE damage immunity, CC immunity, passive dispels/healing, low-HP execute, and element switching while ignoring enemy Resistance.

meta_changes: Introduction of Child of Chaos, a limited-time support capable of switching elements and granting teamwide AoE damage immunity and CC immunity.
tips: Save up to 300 dice for Child of Chaos's limited banner.
Build full Attack on Child of Chaos to maximize the damage bonus granted to allies under the Ethereal effect.
Do not build Accuracy on Child of Chaos because his exclusive talent allows him to ignore enemy Resistance.
Target Inspiration 1 if pulling duplicates, as it adds massive 10-second teamwide buffs and enemy debuffs.
